build_bm_graph_with_distributions: build a BMGraphBuilder graph with Beta, Normal, and Bernoulli distributions and sample nodes
fix_problems_type_mismatch: fix type mismatches in a BMGraphBuilder graph by inserting ToReal and ToPosReal conversion nodes
test_fix_problems_unfixable_errors: test that fix_problems reports errors for unfixable issues like negative standard deviation or out-of-range probabilities
convert_division_to_multiplication: convert a division by a constant into a multiplication by its reciprocal in a BMGraphBuilder graph
rewrite_chi2_to_gamma: rewrite a Chi2 distribution node into an equivalent Gamma distribution in a BMGraphBuilder graph
